For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Various commands for working with matrices.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> matrix {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Notes
You must use one of the following subcommands. Using this command as-is will only produce this help message.

## Subcommands:

| name                                                     | description                                                                              | type     |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| [`matrix add`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_add/)             | Add a matrix or scalar to a matrix.                                                      | built-in |
| [`matrix get-col`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_get-col/)     | Extract a column from a 2D matrix.                                                       | built-in |
| [`matrix get-row`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_get-row/)     | Extract a row from a matrix.                                                             | built-in |
| [`matrix identity`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_identity/)   | Create an identity matrix of the given size.                                             | built-in |
| [`matrix into-nu`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_into-nu/)     | Convert a matrix to a nushell table (list of lists by default).                          | built-in |
| [`matrix map`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_map/)             | Apply a closure to each element of a matrix and return a new matrix.                     | built-in |
| [`matrix max`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_max/)             | Find the maximum value in a matrix, or max along an axis.                                | built-in |
| [`matrix mean`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_mean/)           | Compute the mean of all elements in a matrix.                                            | built-in |
| [`matrix multiply`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_multiply/)   | Multiply two matrices using dot product.                                                 | built-in |
| [`matrix reduce`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_reduce/)       | Reduce all elements of a matrix to a single value.                                       | built-in |
| [`matrix reshape`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_reshape/)     | Change the dimensions of a matrix.                                                       | built-in |
| [`matrix scale`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_scale/)         | Multiply all elements of a matrix by a scalar.                                           | built-in |
| [`matrix set-col`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_set-col/)     | Replace a column in a 2D matrix.                                                         | built-in |
| [`matrix set-row`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_set-row/)     | Replace a row in a matrix.                                                               | built-in |
| [`matrix subtract`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_subtract/)   | Subtract a matrix or scalar from a matrix.                                               | built-in |
| [`matrix sum`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_sum/)             | Sum all elements of a matrix, or sum along an axis.                                      | built-in |
| [`matrix transpose`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_transpose/) | Transpose a matrix (swap rows and columns). For n-dimensional arrays, reverses all axes. | built-in |
| [`matrix zeros`](/docs/shell/commands/matrix_zeros/)         | Create a matrix filled with zeros.                                                       | built-in |
